special_situations.headline: Newspaper publication of commencement of the pre-packaged insolvency resolution process.
special_situations.summary: Newspaper notice confirms formal commencement of pre-packaged insolvency process (PPIRP).
special_situations.impact: No deal figure; qualitative distress event. FY26 revenue rose 48% to ₹126.58 Cr but net profit crashed 91% to ₹0.20 Cr
special_situations.risk: NCLT approval still pending; auditor flagged unverified bank account and heavy write-offs
special_situations.view_reasoning: Sharp profit collapse, write-offs of ₹1.89 Cr inventory + ₹2.88 Cr liabilities alongside distress restructuring.

special_situations.headline: Resignation of Statutory Auditor - M/S R.B. Jain & Associates
special_situations.summary: Statutory auditor R.B. Jain & Associates resigns shortly after being appointed for 5-year term.
special_situations.impact: No deal figure; qualitative governance signal for a company that just exited CIRP in Dec 2023
special_situations.risk: No disclosed reason found for abrupt exit right after a 5-year appointment
special_situations.view_reasoning: Auditor resigning almost immediately after a fresh 5-year appointment at a recently-CIRP-exited firm is an unusual red flag.

special_situations.subcategory: Award of Order / Receipt of Order
special_situations.headline: We are pleased to inform you that the Company has been Awarded the Letter of award from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) at Madangundi Fee Plaza.
special_situations.summary: Awarded NHAI toll-collection LOA for Madangundi Fee Plaza, Jharkhand.
special_situations.impact: ~₹28.47 Cr order value, roughly 5% of annualized revenue (~₹532 Cr, based on trailing 4-quarter average of ₹132.97 Cr/quarter)
special_situations.risk: Company continues to report negative operating cash flows despite revenue growth
special_situations.view_reasoning: Repeated small NHAI toll wins add revenue visibility, but persistent negative operating cashflow is a concern per recent analyst notes.

special_situations.headline: Full and Final Settlement w.r.t. Insolvency petition filed against Sherisha Solar LLP and completion of internal restructuring.
special_situations.summary: Full-and-final ₹16.51 Cr settlement resolves insolvency petition against subsidiary Sherisha Solar LLP.
special_situations.impact: ₹16.51 Cr settled vs ₹33.39 Cr claimed; roughly 26% of trailing 12-month revenue (~₹62 Cr per market data, though this figure looks unusually low vs market cap)
special_situations.risk: Recurring insolvency/legal actions at subsidiary level; prior IT search and promoter reclassification issues
special_situations.view_reasoning: Removes a legal overhang and stops a Section 7 IBC case, but repeated subsidiary-level distress episodes warrant caution.

special_situations.subcategory: Award of Order / Receipt of Order
special_situations.headline: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Receipt of Letter of Award
special_situations.summary: Received Letter of Award, likely for the 230 MW SECI FDRE RTC tender won at ₹5.26/unit.
special_situations.impact: 230 MW addition is ~2.9% of ~7,910 MW total portfolio; FY26 revenue was ₹719-805 Cr (sources vary) with 41% YoY growth
special_situations.risk: High leverage (debt/equity ~3.77x), recent IPO (Aug 2026) with limited FDRE execution track record
special_situations.view_reasoning: Solid revenue growth and top-10 IPP status, but heavy leverage and newly-listed status make near-term risk/reward unclear.

fallen_ipos.view_reasoning: Listing fall was geopolitical shock, but stock later hit new lows even as textile sector rallied, signaling stock-specific weakness.
Initial dip was market-wide, but later 20% single-day crash coincided with rumor clarifications, despite FY26 revenue/profit growth intact.
Flat listing fall reflected cautious sentiment, not fundamentals; FY26 revenue and net profit both grew sharply.
